title: *GENERAL PHYSICS WITH CALCULUS
description: Extends and adapts models based on forces and energy to describe and quantify the fundamental physical phenomena of rotational motion, oscillatory motion, collective motion, and optics.  Explores how multiple representations, mathematical sensemaking, and physical explanations strengthen the construction and deployment of the models. Investigates the methods by which physics is built through experiment and observation.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (PH 211 or 211H) and (MTH 252Z, 252HZ, 252 or 252H).
A minimum grade of C- is required in PH 211, PH 211H, MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252 and MTH 252H.
meeting_html: F 10am-11:50am in WNGR 238 - Weniger Hall 238 (9/23 to 12/4)
